verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents event-triggered automated scanning: CI jobs on push and PR/MR events, and Managed Scans that onboard and scan repositories without CI changes. Follow-up actions also run unattended, including automated PR comments, secrets comments in PRs, and alerts or tickets. These are rule- and event-driven scan automations, not user-defined autonomous background agents, and the CI path relies on the host CI provider. missing for 10: user-configurable recurring or scheduled automations, an autonomous agentic background workflow builder, evidence on how Managed Scans trigger and schedule scans, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: consider Semgrep Managed Scans, which enables you to bulk onboard and scan your repositories without requiring changes to your CI
